result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but there is one obvious missing icon in the bottom navigation and a minor text-truncation issue in the horizontal restaurant list.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar has no icon above its label, while Home, Search, and Profile all have icons.
issues.suggestion: Add an orders/receipt icon to the Orders tab so it matches the visual affordance of the other tabs.

issues.description: The third card in the Fastest near you section shows a truncated restaurant name, 'Trattoria Piccol', instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Use text-overflow ellipsis or increase the card width so the full restaurant name is readable.
